conversion.continuous_score: S is geometric mean of per-workload median of seven paired naive/candidate timing ratios; 0 if S <= 1, else 100*log(S)/(log(10)+log(S)).
conversion.pass_fail: On every selected workload: candidate median search latency < optimized reference latency, candidate worst timed iso-result recall >= reference worst timed recall and candidate worst timed exact nearest-neighbor recall@k >= reference; every timed candidate call must satisfy naive iso-recall >= 0.99.

conversion.distance_validity: For each valid ID: abs(returned-oracle) <= 1e-6*abs(float32 residual ADC oracle), atol0; zero oracle requires exact zero. Legal -1/+inf padding is validated separately and excluded.
